paragraphs: I'm applying for the Manager, Finance role on the Engineering Finance team in Operations and Technology. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I spent about five and a half years at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. What draws me to this role is the mix: it covers the full planning cycle and the monthly close for a shared service group that touches every part of NBCU.

At Thomson Reuters I worked with finance teams on monthly P&L forecasting, variance analysis and closing activities for the ANZ region, and managed cash flow analysis covering 80%+ of total inflows. At Lenovo I built forecasts and scenario models that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and ran variance and sensitivity analyses on budget reallocation that I turned into clear recommendations for stakeholders.

That lines up with leading close deliverables, consolidating OCF, capital and headcount across lines of business, and explaining results to leadership. I've worked in SAP and I'm comfortable automating reporting so more time goes to the analysis. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
